answer: The graph explorer draws from the `relation` index. That index was introduced in 2.9.0, the same release that added the experimental Object Graph explorer (see `CHANGELOG.md`). The changelog doesn't give a release date.

40:  * [[Tag/data]] block keys can no longer overwrite `ref`, `tag` or `itags`, and relations from data blocks now point at the object they’re written in. A data block named after a built-in tag (` ```#task `) is no longer indexed. Lint flags it.
208:* Fix: only the first entry of a frontmatter list of wiki links formed a [[Tag/relation|relation]] (e.g. an `authors:` list of `[[...]]` items), so every entry after the first was missing from [[Object Graph]], linked mentions and rename refactoring.
231:* New [[Tag/relation|relation]] indexed object capturing generalized object-to-object relationships. This is a successor to `link`, which still exists as a virtual collection built on top of `relation`.
232:* New experimental [[Object Graph]]: an interactive, force-directed graph explorer over the [[Tag/relation|relation]] index. Try it via ${widgets.commandButton("Graph: Explore")} and ${widgets.commandButton("Graph: Global Page Map")}.
